tickets.title: Execute one-time IRA withdrawal for remodel
tickets.text: Process a one-time gross distribution of $38,000 from Dorian Pebblefizz's traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to the Teacup Comet Bank checking account to cover the first contractor deposit for the home accessibility remodel.
tickets.evidence: Dorian asked for a $38,000 gross distribution from the traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to be sent to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit, and they agreed to complete the one-time IRA withdrawal by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Change recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Increase the regular gross monthly distribution from Dorian Pebblefizz's traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody from $4,000 to $6,500, update the bank destination to Teacup Comet Bank checking, and revise withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle.
tickets.evidence: Dorian also asked to raise the regular IRA cash flow from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month and to document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle; they agreed to complete the recurring IRA distribution adjustment by 2025-08-20.

tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Update advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions for Dorian Pebblefizz and Elena Pebblefizz to reflect their move from Portland, Oregon to Henderson, Nevada as their primary residence.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: The move from Oregon to Nevada requires advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions to be updated using the new residency facts Dorian provided, and they agreed to complete those updates by 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Resolve Oregon withholding discrepancy
tickets.text: Address the discrepancy where the custodian record at Velvet Acorn Custody still shows Oregon state withholding on Dorian Pebblefizz's recurring IRA distribution despite the household's primary residence being in Henderson, Nevada.
tickets.evidence: The custodian record still shows Oregon state withholding on the recurring IRA distribution even though Dorian described the Henderson home as the current primary residence and did not expect Oregon withholding on future payments; they agreed to address the Oregon withholding discrepancy on IRA paym

tickets.title: Review ACH timing and bank instructions
tickets.text: Check the payment timing and bank instruction history regarding the recent IRA ACH deposit that reached Teacup Comet Bank later than expected, causing Dorian Pebblefizz to move money manually from savings to cover household bills.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that the payment timing and bank instruction history need to be checked by 2025-08-18.

tickets.title: Request and organize estate document copies
tickets.text: Collect current copies of Dorian Pebblefizz and Elena Pebblefizz's wills, powers of attorney, trust amendment pages if applicable, and beneficiary confirmations for recordkeeping and planning review, as the advisory file only contains older 2018 documents.
tickets.evidence: Because only older estate papers are available in the advisory file, they agreed that current wills, powers of attorney, trust amendment pages if applicable, and beneficiary confirmations need to be collected for recordkeeping and planning review by 2025-09-05.

tickets.title: Compare funding sources for cash needs
tickets.text: Compare IRA distributions, taxable cash, and selective sales of Paper Otter Components stock in the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody to develop a cash-raising plan that does not assume the employer stock is the first funding source.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review noted a large Paper Otter Components position in the joint taxable account, so they agreed that the cash-raising plan should compare IRA distributions, taxable cash, and selective sales without assuming the employer stock is the first funding source, with the review due by 2025-09-12.
